# ADR-002: Run curation in a separate background service (pan-memoryd)

## Context

Proposed by the assistant in reply to "Where should curation run?"; confirmed by the user: "yes, go with the separate service".

## Decision

- Run curation in a separate background service (pan-memoryd); the plugin only writes events to a durable spool. (observed)

## Consequences
